title: M/S Mohan Elctro Casting Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dr. Dhananjaya Yeshwant Chandrachud, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as infructuous; liberty if cause survives.
headnote: Writ originally challenging Clause 4.20(g) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, later confined to interest on security, dismissed as infructuous after Registry listing with no objection; liberty reserved if the cause of action survives.
facts: M/S Mohan Elctro Casting Pvt. Ltd. sued Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited in 2006. On 19 February 2016 counsel did not press Prayer-A, which sought to declare Clause 4.20(g) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 invalid, and confined the writ to interest on the security deposit under a Government Order dated 10 September 2013. Time was given to file that order and, later, a supplementary affidavit. The Registry then listed the petition as likely infructuous.

holding_units.holding: The Registry classified and listed the writ as likely infructuous and invited objections; none were received. The Court dismissed the petition as infructuous, with liberty to move an appropriate application if the cause of action survives, and with no order as to costs.

not_decided.point: Validity of Clause 4.20(g) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Prayer-A not pressed on 19.2.2016; never decided.

not_decided.point: Interest on security deposit under G.O. dated 10 September 2013
not_decided.note: Writ was confined to this claim but dismissed as infructuous without a merits ruling.
